title: Tabata Volcano
description: Tabata 8 rounds of volcanic power: pop squats, v-ups, star jumps and no-push-up burpees

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Quick lateral shuffles, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Pop squats
exercises.instructions: Jump feet wide into a squat, jump feet together

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs simultaneously to touch feet

exercises.name: Star jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs into a star

exercises.name: No-push-up burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop down, jump feet back, return, jump up

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
